description: Repo hygiene for T1 item 10. local_only checks need the verification toolchain; the signoff.yml runner skips them under --check. Supersedes manifests/item10-inventory-7.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-7.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed .github/workflows/signoff.yml before issue #85 added the item-9 re-attest leg to that workflow and repointed the item-10 step at this pair; the same hygiene entries and the previous checks are carried unchanged. -7 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-6.json and manifests/item10-attestation-6.json, which hashed verification/README.md and .github/workflows/rtl-ci.yml before PR #95 single-sourced the negctl must-fail contract into verification/negctl.sh and issue #90 replaced the loose-tolerance generator smoke in rtl/gen/tests/test_gen.py with verification/test_gen_exact.py (bit-exact vs the fixed-point model at six configurations), wired into rtl-ci.yml as the gen-exact / gen-exact-negctl make targets; those two checks join this inventory so the bit-exactness evidence is attested. -6 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-5.json and manifests/item10-attestation-5.json, which hashed verification/README.md before its negctl.sh single-sourcing (PR #95). -5 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-4.json and manifests/item10-attestation-4.json, which hashed the README.md and the .github/workflows/signoff.yml of issue #79 before the Reproduce-table pointer fix. -4 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-3.json and manifests/item10-attestation-3.json, which hashed the README.md before the status alignment of issue #62. -3 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-2.json and manifests/item10-attestation-2.json, whose checks (lint, sim, negctl) and hygiene entry measurements/synth-placeholder.json cover the retired placeholder flow. measurements/synth-placeholder.json is retained as history; the live synthesis record is measurements/fft256-smoke.json.
